description: Clean, fully customizable hitboxes for Minecraft. A client side Fabric mod for 1.21.11 and 26.x with 36k+ downloads on Modrinth.

mods.name: Hitbox Plus+
mods.description: A fabric mod for Hitboxes, highly configurable. Customize widths, apply dynamic combat coloring, and tailor the visual rendering pipeline to your exact specifications.

releases.notes:
## Hitbox+ 1.3.0 for Minecraft 26.3

### New: Players tab and Team Color
* New **Players** tab in the config screen with a **Team Color** page
* Teammates get their own hitbox color, and rainbow works too
* Add players from the config screen with name autocomplete, or from chat with `/hbteam add`, `remove`, `list` and `clear`
* The team list shows each player's skin face

### Also in this release
* First public source release. The full code is now on GitHub under the MIT License
* Builds pick the right JDK automatically

### Requirements
Fabric Loader, [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) and [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)

Also on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/hitbox-plus). Full history in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ItzzWater/Hitbox-Plus/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
